threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the CAD application servers, integration engine, and communications center consoles, forcing manual dispatch at both centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consoles run EDR in detect-only mode and are patched quarterly; both centers depend on one cloud CAD; CAD rebuild never tested; integration engine not in write-once backups
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-11; BP-01 to BP-04
existing_controls: MFA for all workforce sign-ins; EDR with 24x7 MSSP on servers and office devices; write-once CAD database copies in the backup account; manual dispatch binder; county P25 radio
treatment_plan: EDR to block mode on consoles with CAD vendor approval; monthly console patching; write-once backups for the integration engine and recordings; CAD rebuild test; ransomware manual dispatch drill at both centers; warm CAD standby in the backup region
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (manual operations, recovery, response, notification; insurance limit $10M)

threat_event: Exfiltration of CAD incident data, call recordings, or ePCR exports for extortion before or during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress volume alerting; reporting database extracts unrestricted; CAD and integration engine logs not in the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 database; call recording archive; SYS-06 data and reporting account
regulatory_driver: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (164.402-164.410); Fla. Stat. 501.171
existing_controls: EDR; SIEM on identity provider, EDR, firewall, and cloud control-plane logs; encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Egress alerting on the cloud hub; restrict reporting extracts to named analysts; send CAD and integration engine logs to the SIEM
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$6M (up to about 450,000 patient records from 3 years of CAD data; counsel, forensics, notification, monitoring)

threat_event: CAD cannot be rebuilt within the 1-hour RTO after a destructive event because the application servers and integration engine have never been rebuilt in a test
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only the CAD database restore has been tested (2025-10); application reinstall depends on the CAD vendor
existing_controls: Database point-in-time restore; vendor support contract; manual dispatch
treatment_plan: Documented rebuild runbook with the CAD vendor; full rebuild test in the isolated recovery network; quarterly restore tests
exposure_estimate_usd: $300,000-$1.5M (days of manual operations at both centers)

threat_event: Attacker exploits an unpatched operating system flaw on a communications center console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consoles patched quarterly (last 2026-05); EDR in detect-only mode
existing_controls: Console image hardened; console segment firewalled from office devices at headquarters
treatment_plan: Monthly console patching with a CAD vendor compatibility list; EDR block mode

threat_event: A stolen MDC or misuse of a per-vehicle CAD account exposes incident data and cannot be attributed to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 92 per-vehicle CAD accounts with automatic sign-in and no MFA
existing_controls: Device encryption and remote wipe; VPN certificate per vehicle; read-only mobile role
treatment_plan: Named crew sign-in with MFA on MDCs through the identity provider

threat_event: A former field employee signs in to the ePCR after leaving and views patient records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ePCR accounts managed locally and disabled by ticket; 6 of 25 sampled departures kept access 4 to 19 days
existing_controls: Identity provider disabled the same day; ePCR requires MFA through the identity provider for web access
treatment_plan: SCIM provisioning from the identity provider to the ePCR; weekly departures reconciliation until then

threat_event: Attacker reaches the VPN through an unmanaged vehicle router with outdated firmware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 35 of 106 routers outside central management; remote web administration enabled; pre-shared keys
existing_controls: Router VPN limited to the vehicle address range; firewall rules in the hub
treatment_plan: Enroll all routers in central management; disable remote administration; certificates for all

threat_event: CAD is unavailable for more than 1 hour because of a cloud region failure or a CAD software fault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Active and standby CAD servers are in one region; no warm standby elsewhere
existing_controls: Active and standby servers; provider multi-zone database; manual dispatch
treatment_plan: Warm CAD standby in the backup region

threat_event: A hurricane disables the headquarters communications center and degrades the backup center at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Both centers are within about 25 miles; both depend on regional power, carriers, and the same cloud CAD
existing_controls: Backup center with generator and two ISPs; annual relocation drill; county P25 radio
treatment_plan: Pre-storm staffing plan; deployable console kit with cellular links; mutual aid for out-of-region dispatch support

threat_event: The County A CAD-to-CAD interface fails and 911 incidents stop arriving electronically
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No agreed outage procedure or monitoring of message flow with County A
existing_controls: County A voice-announces calls; callers are still transferred by phone
treatment_plan: Heartbeat monitoring of the interface; written outage procedure with each county

threat_event: Attacker compromises a county CAD and uses the CAD-to-CAD link to reach the integration engine
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No interconnection security terms; message input not validated
existing_controls: Listener accepts only each county's address range; TLS
treatment_plan: Interconnection security terms with both counties; input validation; move links to site-to-site VPN

threat_event: Business email compromise of the revenue cycle mailbox leads to diversion of client remittances or exposure of PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remittance change requests accepted by email; billing services staff not trained on payment change fraud
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; targeted training for revenue cycle staff

threat_event: A breach at the billing platform vendor exposes company PHI and the PHI of the 4 billing services clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor holds all company and client claims data; company has not reviewed client workspace separation; client notice duties not built into procedures
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R04 (164.308(b)(1); 164.314(a)(2)(iii)); HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (164.402-164.410); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (third-party agent)
existing_controls: BAA with the vendor; vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report; MFA on platform sign-in
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review with CUEC mapping; vendor breach runbook (P08); client notice templates; 5-business-day breach notice term at renewal
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$4M (notices for company and client patients; client contract claims)

threat_event: Billing services staff see or send one client's patient data to another client because of a workspace misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workspace permissions set by the vendor and never reviewed; staff work across all client workspaces
existing_controls: Role-based access in the billing platform
treatment_plan: Review workspace settings with the vendor; assign staff to client teams; quarterly access review

threat_event: AI coding assistance (AI-003) assigns a higher level of service or wrong codes, producing Medicare and Medicaid overpayments on company and client claims
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 35% of claims are coded straight through without coder review when model confidence is high; no accuracy monitoring
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R04 (164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B)); 42 CFR 401.305 (report and return overpayments within 60 days of identification)
treatment_plan: End straight-through coding; 100% coder review; monthly accuracy audit; look-back review of straight-through claims

threat_event: AI call triage (AI-001) misses a critical keyword or anchors a telecommunicator to a lower priority on a time-critical call
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Advisory mode in use since 2026-05-01 without a validation threshold for Spanish calls; prompts appear before the EMD protocol is complete
existing_controls: Upgrade-only prompts; telecommunicators complete the EMD protocol
treatment_plan: Go-live criteria in P10; English-only advisory mode until Spanish sensitivity meets threshold; monthly under-triage report

threat_event: Posting recommendations (AI-004) leave some neighborhoods with consistently longer response times
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model trained on call history that reflects past coverage; no monitoring of response times by area
existing_controls: Supervisors approve each move; county reports by zone
treatment_plan: Monthly response-time equity report by area; supervisor override logging

threat_event: AI narrative drafting (AI-002) adds care that was not given, or omits care that was, in signed patient care records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Crews can sign drafts without editing; no accuracy sampling
treatment_plan: Monthly sample of 30 drafted narratives; attestation at signing

threat_event: The AI triage vendor keeps call audio longer than needed or uses it to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI feature enabled under an order form whose data-use terms allow 30-day retention and do not exclude training
treatment_plan: BAA amendment with no-training, no-secondary-use, and 7-day deletion terms

threat_event: Staff paste PHI or caller details into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved alternative until the AI-005 pilot; public sites not blocked
treatment_plan: Block public chatbots on managed devices; roll out AI-005 under BAA

threat_event: Compromise of the MSSP or CAD vendor remote access gives attackers administrator access to CAD and endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CAD vendor uses its own remote tool with a standing account; MSSP holds EDR administrator rights
treatment_plan: Vendor access through a company-controlled broker with session approval and recording; annual vendor SOC 2 and CUEC review

threat_event: A cloud administrator account is taken over through MFA fatigue or phishing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for administrators; standing administrator roles
existing_controls: Number matching; conditional access; separate admin accounts
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant security keys for administrators; just-in-time elevation

threat_event: A device on crew Wi-Fi at a station reaches workstations or station alerting controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network at 9 of 13 stations
treatment_plan: Separate crew Wi-Fi, station alerting, and workstation segments at 9 stations

threat_event: Field staff credentials are phished and used to view patient records in the ePCR
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High field staff turnover; training completed on tablets during shifts
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Role-based phishing training for field staff; impossible-travel alerts in the SIEM

threat_event: Staff do not report a suspected incident, so discovery and notice clocks start late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field staff rarely use the service desk; reporting path not in station posters
treatment_plan: Reporting card on every MDC and in stations; supervisor reporting drill

threat_event: The cardiac monitor relay service fails and 12-lead ECGs stop reaching hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single relay vendor
existing_controls: Crews phone findings to the emergency department
treatment_plan: Accepted: phone reports are a safe workaround; vendor uptime reviewed yearly

threat_event: A lost or stolen tablet or MDC exposes cached patient records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets travel in vehicles and to hospitals
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes a loss a non-breach under the safe harbor for secured PHI

threat_event: A telephony denial-of-service attack floods request lines so facilities cannot book transports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Request lines published on the website
existing_controls: Vendor call filtering; facility direct lines
treatment_plan: Accepted: vendor protection and alternate lines are sufficient

threat_event: A supervisor edits unit times in CAD to meet county response-time standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supervisors can edit times with a reason code; edits not reviewed
existing_controls: Edits logged with user and reason
treatment_plan: Monthly review of time edits by the Director of Government Contracts

threat_event: A patient care record or PCS is faxed or emailed to the wrong facility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual fax and email workflows for records requests
existing_controls: Fax cover sheets; verification of numbers
treatment_plan: Use the ePCR hospital portal for record requests; saved facility contacts

threat_event: HHS OCR enforcement after a breach shows that risk management actions from the prior analysis were not tracked to closure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 15 actions from the July 2025 analysis were still open at the 2026 analysis
treatment_plan: Quarterly POA&M review by the COO and the audit committee

threat_event: Medicare denies or recoups claims because PCS documents from 2023-2024 were deleted under the 2-year mailbox setting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud fax archive and shared mailbox delete after 2 years
existing_controls: PCS attached to billing records since January 2025
treatment_plan: Suspend deletion; export remaining PCS to the billing platform; 7-year retention

threat_event: A patient care record is not available to the receiving hospital within 48 hours of a request
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Delivery failures to 2 hospitals are not monitored
treatment_plan: Weekly failed-delivery report

threat_event: A ransom is paid to a sanctioned party under pressure to restore CAD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written ransom decision procedure in the 2023 plan
treatment_plan: Ransom decision procedure with OFAC check in P08

threat_event: Attacker exploits a flaw in an internet-facing firewall or VPN appliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge appliance firmware updated quarterly; known exploited vulnerabilities not tracked weekly
treatment_plan: Weekly known-exploited vulnerability review; 7-day patch target for edge devices

threat_event: Large extracts from the reporting database leave the company unnoticed
threat_source: Insider or attacker with analyst credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Analysts can export full incident tables; no egress alerting
treatment_plan: Restrict exports; egress alerting; quarterly analyst access review

threat_event: County A asks the company to receive law enforcement premise hazard and officer-safety flags through CAD-to-CAD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accepting the data would bring criminal justice information into CAD without a CJIS program
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R01 (CJIS Security Policy v6.1, if CJI were received)
treatment_plan: Do not accept CJI feeds unless a CJIS program, agreement, and security addendum are in place first; offer EMS-only hazard flags

threat_event: A workforce member looks up the patient record of a coworker, neighbor, or public figure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No proactive ePCR access review; CAD query review never done
treatment_plan: Monthly ePCR access analytics; CAD query review for high-profile incidents

threat_event: Security documentation and incident records are not retained for 6 years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records spread across email and the service desk
treatment_plan: Central GRC repository with 6-year retention

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes the call recording archive or reporting data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration standard for cloud workloads
existing_controls: Guardrails block public storage; posture service
treatment_plan: Configuration standard STD-01; weekly posture review

threat_event: Logs are insufficient to show what an attacker accessed, so a breach must be presumed for all records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CAD logs kept 30 days and integration engine logs 14 days, outside the SIEM
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R04 (164.312(b)); HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (164.402-164.410) (164.402 risk assessment)
treatment_plan: Send CAD, integration engine, and ePCR audit logs to the SIEM with 1-year retention
exposure_estimate_usd: $500,000-$3M (notification of all patients when scope cannot be limited)

threat_event: Response to a CAD ransomware event is uncoordinated with the counties, hospitals, and insurer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2023 plan not updated; no joint exercise since 2024
treatment_plan: P08 runbooks; joint tabletop with both counties 2027-01-20

threat_event: PHI is shared with 6 vendors that have no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Purchasing gate not enforced before 2026
treatment_plan: Execute BAAs or stop PHI flows; purchasing gate

threat_event: Billing services clients do not renew because the company cannot provide a SOC 2 Type 2 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 program; readiness gaps (P09)
treatment_plan: SOC 2 readiness and Type 2 observation period starting 2027-04-01 (P09)

threat_event: A CAD vendor update or configuration change breaks dispatch functions during a busy period
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integration engine changes not peer reviewed; vendor updates tested only briefly
treatment_plan: Test environment for CAD updates; second reviewer for interface changes

threat_event: A regional cellular carrier outage disables MDCs, AVL, and ePCR sync
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Routers use one primary carrier with a second SIM on 40 routers
treatment_plan: Accepted: radio and offline tablets are adequate; dual-carrier SIMs added at router refresh

threat_event: A ransomware attack or outage at the billing platform halts company and client claims for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single billing platform and clearinghouse for both lines of business
treatment_plan: Vendor outage procedures in the P08 billing runbook; cash-flow plan; client communication templates

threat_event: A clinician works with an expired certification because the credential tracking data is wrong
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scheduling system accounts managed locally; manual certification updates
treatment_plan: Weekly automated expiry report to supervisors

threat_event: CAD address or map data is altered so units are sent to the wrong location
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Map updates loaded by 2 administrators without review
treatment_plan: Second review for map loads; integrity check against county address data

threat_event: An attacker on crew Wi-Fi logs in to a station alerting controller with the default password and suppresses or falsely triggers station alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controllers at 9 stations reachable from crew Wi-Fi; 4 still had the manufacturer default password (P07, 2026-08-12)
existing_controls: Default passwords changed on 2026-08-14 for the 4 controllers
treatment_plan: Isolate controllers on their own segment; vendor remote access through the broker; password vault
